title: AI Agent Audit Log: See Every Command It Ran
description:
What did your AI agent just run? Log it and find out. 🔍

✅ Write a small hook script with jq
✅ Append every tool and command to audit.log
✅ Register it on PostToolUse and read the log

Day 10 of Safe AI Agents, the last one! Next up: a new series, Spec-Driven AI, starting with Day 1: Write a Spec Your Agent Can Follow.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to build with AI the right way.

#shorts #aiagents #aicoding #claudecode #cybersecurity #tech #ai
comment: Hook logs or diff review: which first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: add .claude/audit.log to .gitignore so your log stays on your machine.
